## Requirements: Project Session creation previews and prepares Image Toolchain Workspace resources

**Priority:** P2. **Owner:** Project/Session UI / Server-Agent orchestration.

### Execution priority revision · 2026-11-17

Wave 3 — Project/Session convergence once Image Library/Build/Distribution (#3799, #3795, #3796), picker #3793 and Linux Host-root consumption #3792 are ready. No new Project-owned image registry.

### Problem and required behavior
A Project stays a declaration, not a second runtime owner. Extend New Session interaction to choose/derive Host vs EROFS Base, bound Project Source image, ordered Toolchains, Workspace (Project Location or Agent managed), and ENV; present fully resolved identities and compatibility/readiness before explicit Create. Keep new Session pinned to its realized snapshot. Remove obsolete unconditional 'Managed not available' entry in favor of actual capability-gated Managed/Host options; never silently fallback to Native.

**Source audit (2026-11-17 main):** `web/src/product/session/hooks/useCreateSessionForm.ts`, `web/src/product/session/components/CreateSessionDialog.tsx`, `web/src/product/project/components/ProjectDetail.tsx`. Linked accepted boundaries: #3062 #3025 #3649 #3407 #3499 #3435. Preserve existing historical Acceptance; this Requirement owns **new product behavior**, not a re-verdict on those Issues.

### Design boundary and ordering
- Production owner remains as above; never introduce duplicate Image Registry/Build queue/Agent cache or global Sandbox Workspace.
- Preserve one pinned immutable Digest and explicit ownership/recovery through the Session/Workspace lifecycle; do not silently fall back when the necessary capability is absent.
- Web/App use current Nession ResourceDetail/ConfigurationForm/OperationSurface, one shell/Header owner, progressive disclosure. No unverified behavior may be presented as shipped.
- This Issue may be developed independently, but contracts shared with #3062 #3025 #3649 #3407 #3499 #3435 require a source-aligned review before implementation.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Web/App New Session shows Project defaults and explicit overrides, effective Agent/Workspace/Image/Toolchain/ENV preview, a separate explicit Create step, and clear recoverable absent/offline/incompatible cases without losing draft or silently changing existing Sessions.
- [ ] SC-02 A created Session persists immutable resolved image/tool digests and Workspace binding; changing Project references afterwards leaves the running Session unchanged, and a failed prepare does not create a Native fallback or delete another Workspace.
- [x] SC-03 Session create request/prepare validates references against the selected Agent and prevents accidental use of stale Project digest when Git Source changes.

**Verification scenarios:** SC-01 → SCN-02; SC-02 → SCN-03; SC-03 → SCN-01. PR `agent` decisions consume only exact-SHA source/deterministic CI proof; merged `case` runs reuse approved Nession Chromium Web/App and/or isolated Server-Agent Linux runtime lanes, with trusted Run/Attempt/SHA receipts. Native mount guarantees require actual capability-probed Linux runner; no mock-only Pass.
